about_the_game:
「Pretty Dreadful」 is a story driven point&click adventure.

Re:do had big dreams and goals he tried to achieve in a big city. However, having graduated, he realized that he doesn’t know what to do with his life.

Though he cannot remember a thing from his own past, Re:do believes he is a regular guy who is destined to have a regular life. Yet, no one can run away from their past, even from the forgotten one.

Granny unexpectedly sends a farewell letter. A strange but familiar two-tailed fox visits Re:do in his dreams. Creepy creatures start walking among people but no one seems to notice them. Re:do has to remember who he was and who he is. And his destiny is not what he thought it would be at all.

Features:

  • Story driven adventure game.

  • Pretty anime-like art-style with a bit of creepiness.

  • Simple puzzles meant to complete the gameplay without challenging your skills.

  • Vibe of old Japan from the 90-s.

  • A mystery that is yet to be revealed.

  • Several endings.
